necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93229 was denied under code PR-204, but the service is medically necessary for the patient with diagnosis codes R55 and I48.0. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management.
